definitions.full_request_tps: real delivered output tokens / wall from enqueue to all requests finished
definitions.decode_span_tps: decode-delivered tokens / (last decode end - first decode start), including host gaps
definitions.full_batch_prefix_tps: tokens / span of initial consecutive decode rounds with requested B
definitions.delivery_gap: one interval between real delivery batches, not SSE and no per-token interpolation
definitions.tau: real delivered tokens per decode sequence-round; separate from accepted/proposed fraction
definitions.diagnostic: diagnostic instruments and forced acceptance are never primary throughput
definitions.weights: model provenance uses path, config hash, file names and sizes; not a full weight-content hash
definitions.memory: allocator totals and named tensors/graph pools may overlap; do not sum them

scope: nano-vLLM internal fixed-batch; BF16 Qwen3-4B + official DSpark block7, W512 ring; prefix/mixed off; output256; T1; not HTTP/vLLM/SGLang comparison
